description:
## [1.28.1](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/compare/v1.28.0...v1.28.1) (2026-10-16)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* recommend Codecs Support on 2.0.20/5001712 ([6042535](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/60425356ab125ca38d9b5593bec3c5bf22f1fcba))

patches.name: 5.1-channel audio bridge (4XVR)
patches.description: Routes the AAudio calls of Vr4pMediaPlayer and its audio runnable through the bundled 5.1-channel bridge, initializes the bridge in Main4XActivity and refreshes the subtitle style on the playback-speed tick for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Audio bridge payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Installs the bundled 5.1-channel AAudio bridge native for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Frame-synced render dispatch (4XVR)
patches.description: Drains the render dispatch queue before every frame, hands scene switches to RenderDispatch.requestScene instead of the retired render runnable, and routes window teardown through the dispatch for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR controller models (4XVR)
patches.description: Replaces the four Quest 3 controller assets with the Galaxy XR reference models (2048x2048 textures, re-authored meshes) for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Static asset swap; headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR launch compatibility (4XVR)
patches.description: Installs the Khronos OpenXR loader 1.1.58, the 4XVR view-config API layer and the Galaxy XR manifest declarations (OpenXR 1.1, passthrough, hand and eye input) for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Decoded-base adaptation; headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR launcher icon (4XVR)
patches.description: Re-exposes the stock 4XVR launcher artwork under the canonical ic_launcher/ic_launcher_round names (adaptive icon plus density PNGs) and points the manifest at them, matching the Steam Link icon shape for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR refresh profile (72 Hz, 4XVR)
patches.description: Clamps the InitializeDevice refresh-rate picker floors (121.0f/91.0f -> 73.0f) so exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022 requests Galaxy XR's 72 Hz mode. Three guarded bytes in libvr4p-oculus.so; runtime application pending headset validation. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: HDR pipeline payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Installs the modified libplacebo 7.360.1 (LGPL-2.1-or-later), the 4XVR HDR bridge native and the bundled open-source notices for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Meta platform decoupling (4XVR)
patches.description: Stubs the 11 exported Oculus platform-init/entitlement/message functions in libovrplatformloader.so of exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. The reference Galaxy XR build requires the Meta platform channel to stay inert on a non-Meta runtime: without these stubs the app hangs on the splash — the OpenXR session is created but never presents its first frame (Galaxy XR on-device A/B, 2026-10-12). Meta-store VIP flows degrade. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Popup refresh on resume (4XVR)
patches.description: Re-checks the 4XVR startup popups after the activity resumes or returns from system settings: hides the All-files-access prompt once external storage access is granted (the stock flow never re-checks the result of its 0x59E2 request) and hides the release-notes window when its saved version already covers the installed build, for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Premium unlock (4XVR, experimental)
patches.description: Removes the 4XVR premium gate on Galaxy XR, where the Meta Store cannot be reached to verify a purchase: every start forces the app's own VIP state on through ChangeCurVIPStateClear(true), the same state transition a store purchase applies, so IsMP() is true and the trial playback limiter stays off. The dead Meta-store Buy entry points re-assert the unlocked state instead of calling the native checkout; the Buy buttons are hidden in favor of the Sync slot. Exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Render dispatch payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Installs the 4XVR render dispatch native (frame-synced scene queue and adaptive theater background updates) for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Startup and UI continuity helper (4XVR)
patches.description: Registers the bundled GxrToastContinuity helper, whose I610UEU2AZF3-gated memory-buildup fix and toast continuity keep the Galaxy XR UI pipeline warm across activity recreation, right after Main4XActivity.onCreate for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headless validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Subtitle suite (4XVR)
patches.description: Adds the subtitle position controls row, the enlarged subtitle panel height, immediate config persistence on color-tab changes, the custom subtitle font load and the wrapped-cue size clamp for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Subtitle suite payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Installs the subtitle position native library used by the 4XVR subtitle suite controls on exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: libplacebo HDR pipeline (4XVR)
patches.description: Loads the HDR bridge, routes the decoder output surface through it for the FP16 hand-off, detects HLG from the video MediaFormat and keeps the bridge informed of movie/seek transitions for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR SteamVR driver (galaxyxr)
patches.description: Reports the headset and controllers to SteamVR through the resource-only `galaxyxr` driver installed by Galaxy XR VRLink Setup on the PC: Galaxy XR identity, {galaxyxr} icons, input profiles and controller models, and the calibrated grip offset. Replaces the Meta Quest Pro spoof; the PC driver must be installed or the controllers show no model. Controllers keep the oculus_touch type because vrlink accepts no other.

options.description: Offset of the SteamVR controller origin from the OpenXR grip pose in centimetres: x right, y up along the handle, z backward (negative = forward). Default calibrated on Galaxy XR controllers against the system model. Stock Quest Touch value is -0.7,-3.416,-9.607.
Rotation of the SteamVR controller origin relative to the grip pose in degrees (x pitch, y yaw, z roll). Stock Quest Touch value is -20.6,0,0.

patches.name: Network Optimizations
patches.description: Improves Steam Link 2.0.23's streaming transport: a loss burst large enough to overflow the retransmission-request buffer now re-requests the accumulated missing packets instead of aborting the stream, the frame-reorder (backtrack) window widens from 6 to 12 frames, a momentarily-starving decoder keeps its buffered frames instead of flushing them, and the UDP send buffer for retransmission requests grows from 128 KiB to 1 MiB. No bitrate, resolution or quality setting is changed. Exact 2.0.23/5002363 only; headset validation pending.

patches.name: OLED color calibration
patches.description: Applies OLED gamma/saturation calibration with 8-bit sRGB output, plus optional VD-like SDR foveal processing and a separate foveal gamma. Exact builds 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363; visible improvement needs headset verification.

options.description: Selects gamma and saturation for both layers when the VD options are off, or for the base layer when a VD foveal option is on.
Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.
Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.

VD-informed SDR processing for declared 10-bit input: use highp sampling, retain Valve's decoder colour correction, bypass the calibration profile on the foveal layer, and add no shader noise. The separate foveal gamma adjustment still applies. Output is 8-bit sRGB. Does not negotiate host depth or reproduce VD's raw-YUV decoder import. Mutually exclusive with the 8-bit option and separate blue-noise patch.

Uses the same VD-informed SDR foveal processing for declared 8-bit input, retaining Valve's decoder colour correction while bypassing the calibration profile and adding no shader noise. The separate foveal gamma adjustment still applies. Output is 8-bit sRGB. Cannot recover precision already lost in the source. Mutually exclusive with the 10-bit option and separate blue-noise patch; does not negotiate host depth.

Additional gamma on the foveal layer only, after its colour processing. 1.00 leaves it unchanged; higher values darken shadows and midtones. Try 1.02 first for a lighter foveal region. Works with either VD option or both off, before fade and optional blue-noise dithering. Background calibration and edge blending stay unchanged; this is manual compensation, not a verified seam fix.
